summary: Enhance your managerial skills with Machine Learning for Decision Making training. Learn to leverage data-driven insights for effective leadership and strategy.
lede: Machine learning for managerial decision-making helps leaders assess how predictive models can inform business choices. For managers in analytics, operations, and digital transformation, the course covers preparing and governing data, applying supervised and unsupervised learning, and evaluating model performance. It also introduces TensorFlow, machine-learning project planning, bias and explainability, and ways to connect initiatives with business goals.
audienceIntro: This course is essential for leaders who need to bridge the gap between technical execution and strategic business outcomes in the age of artificial intelligence.
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of business statistics and data analysis. Familiarity with basic Python syntax is helpful but not mandatory, as the focus is on managerial application and interpretation of the TensorFlow® ecosystem.
topics: Data science & machine learning in practice
